quantize_model_with_calib_compressor: create a CalibCompressor instance and call quantize to quantize a PyTorch model using calibration-based weight optimization
quantize_model_with_calibrated_rtn: create a CalibratedRTNCompressor instance and call quantize to perform RTN quantization with optional importance matrix statistics
cache_intermediate_data_gpu_cpu: call try_cache_inter_data_gpucpu to cache block inputs on GPU with automatic CPU fallback when memory is insufficient
quantize_single_decoder_block: call quantize_block to quantize a single transformer decoder block with reference output collection and act-max hooks
run_calibration_for_quantization: call calib to run calibration forward passes on a dataset to collect activation statistics for quantization
